## Notes

### claude_code

1. ⚠️ `session.create` — teamclaw-aicoding-relay has no explicit sessions.create; OCB pre-allocates the sessionKey, first chat.send establishes it.
2. ⚠️ `mcp.tools.call` — Direct tool call only on SDK bridge; CLI bridge routes via chat.
3. ⚠️ `skills.execute` — Triggered via chat (/ <skill-name> or description), not direct exec.

### openclaw

1. ⚠️ `mcp.start` — 通过 mcporter 命令启动
2. ⚠️ `mcp.stop` — 通过 mcporter 命令停止
